chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: Joe Glaser compared with Nazarro
summary: Handled by Glaser at Associated Booking, he says the difference from Nazarro was night and day.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Who was doing that at that time? Do you remember who was handling you at that time?
How did you feel about him?
Was he being fairer with you than you had experienced with Nazarro?

Oh, Lord, the difference was night and day, different as night and day. So much difference, he's a polished man compared to him. You know? He was a pleasure to work for and a pleasure to work with in my book.
